info.name: LX — Learner Experience OS
info.description:
Every /api/v1/lx endpoint, generated from routes/lx/*.js so it cannot drift from the code.

Variables: baseUrl (default http://localhost:3010/api/v1), actorRef.

AT HANDOFF: the x-lx-actor-ref header is the kit's dev auth shim. Replace it with `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` — identity then comes from the JWT and the header is ignored.
